paragraphs: In the morning, a nurse midwife conducts prenatal visits, listens to fetal heart tones, and explains birth preparation. When a patient enters labor, the midwife goes to the delivery room to monitor progress, coach pushing, and conduct a sterile delivery. If the fetal heart rate becomes abnormal, the midwife immediately assesses and refers the patient. After birth, the midwife follows up on breastfeeding and recovery and prepares records and educational content.
